sections.shortTitle: Antiquities Act Application to the Tribal Areas Regulation 1973
sections.description:
Short title  extent and commencement

REGULATION III OF 1973
REGULATION III OF 1973
ANTIQUITIES ACT (APPLICATION
TO THE TRIBAL AREAS) REGULATION, 1973
1. Short
title, extent and commencement.‑(I) This Regulation may be called the
Antiquities Act (Application to the Tribal Areas) Regulation, 1973.
(2) It
extends to the whole of the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas.
(3) It
shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: Antiquities Act Application to the Tribal Areas Regulation 1973
sections.description:
Application of the Antiquities Act 1968 XIV of 1968 to the provincially administered tribal areas

REGULATION III OF 1973
REGULATION III OF 1973
ANTIQUITIES ACT (APPLICATION
TO THE TRIBAL AREAS) REGULATION, 1973
2.
Application of the Antiquities Act, 1968 (XIV of 1968), to the Provincially
Administered Tribal Areas.‑The provisions of the Antiquities Act,
1968 (XIV of 1968), shall apply to the whole of the Provincially Administered
Tribal Areas, subject to the following modifications in its application to the
Tribal Areas of the North‑West Frontier Province, namely :‑
(1) In
Areas to which the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (1 of 1894), does not apply, the
Antiquities Act, 1968 (XIV of 1968), hereinafter referred to as the said Act,
shall have effect as if. In section 7 and subsection (1) of section 16 thereof,
the words, commas, figures and brackets "under the Land Acquisition Act,
1894 (I of 1894), as for a public purpose" were omitted.
(2) In Areas in
which there is no District Judge, references in section 15 of the said Act to the
Court of the District Judge" and "the District Judge" shall be
construed as references to the Assistant Commissioner, Assistant Political
Agent, District Magistrate or Political Agent, as the case may be.
(3) In Areas
in which there is no Sessions Judge, reference in section 28 of the said Act to
"Sessions Judge" shall be construed as reference to "Sub‑Divisional
Officer".
